Name: Decorative Eggs
Author: KediDili
TagLine: Adds many colorful eggs as craftables into your game. Requires JA.
Description:
Decorative Eggs mod currently adds 27 in total gem and animal designed eggs into your game. There are both geode and usual gems.
Almost all have recipes and gift tastes!

Installation Steps: 

Install the latest version of SMAPI.
Install Json Assets.
Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
Run the game using SMAPI.

Troubleshooting : 

-- Please if you see any bugs, report them and add your SMAPI log﻿ (see https://smapi.io/log and follow the intructions there)
